title: DNS tunnelling used for data exfiltration
description: Unusually long DNS queries with encoded payloads were repeatedly sent to an external domain. DNS traffic volume increased significantly during non-business hours.
root_cause: Malware used DNS queries to establish a covert communication channel.
remediation: Blocked the malicious domain, removed the malware, and restricted outbound DNS traffic.
outcome: Confirmed malicious DNS tunnelling and prevented further data transfer.
feedback: Helpful: DNS query analysis identified the covert channel.
lessons: Monitor unusual DNS query lengths, TXT records, and abnormal outbound DNS volumes.

title: Insider threat accessing confidential files
description: An employee account accessed and downloaded an unusually large number of confidential HR documents outside normal working hours.
steps: Notify the security and HR teams
root_cause: Excessive access permissions allowed an account to access documents beyond its normal business requirements.
remediation: Revoked unnecessary permissions, invalidated active sessions, and introduced additional access monitoring.
outcome: Unauthorized access confirmed; no evidence of external transmission was found.
feedback: Helpful: Reviewing access permissions helped establish the scope.
lessons: Apply least privilege and monitor unusual access to sensitive files.

title: Lateral movement through remote administration
description: A compromised workstation initiated unexpected remote service creation and administrative connections to multiple internal servers.
steps: Identify affected accounts and destination servers
Collect authentication and service creation logs
root_cause: Stolen administrative credentials were reused across multiple internal systems.
remediation: Disabled compromised accounts, isolated affected systems, and introduced privileged access restrictions.
outcome: Confirmed lateral movement across three internal servers.
feedback: Helpful: Investigating the source host first limited the investigation scope.
lessons: Monitor unusual administrative logons, remote service creation, and repeated authentication across hosts.

title: Malicious scheduled task establishing persistence
description: An unknown scheduled task executed a suspicious script at regular intervals after user logon. The task was created by an unexpected process.
steps: Inspect the script and parent process
Review other endpoints for similar tasks
root_cause: A malicious script created a scheduled task to maintain access after initial compromise.
remediation: Removed the malicious task, quarantined the script, and scanned related endpoints.
outcome: Confirmed persistence mechanism and removed it successfully.
feedback: Helpful: Task creation history revealed the persistence mechanism.
lessons: Monitor newly created scheduled tasks and investigate unexpected recurring scripts.

title: Destructive activity targeting backup storage
description: Multiple backup snapshots were deleted and backup retention settings were modified by an unexpected administrative session.
root_cause: Compromised privileged credentials were used to tamper with backup infrastructure.
remediation: Disabled compromised credentials, restored backup policies, and secured offline backup copies.
outcome: Confirmed malicious backup tampering; offline backups remained available.
feedback: Helpful: Checking offline backups established recovery options.
lessons: Protect backup infrastructure with separate credentials, immutable storage, and access monitoring.

title: Suspicious dependency in software supply chain
description: A recently introduced third-party package contained an unexpected installation script that attempted to contact an unfamiliar external host during the build process.
root_cause: An unverified third-party dependency introduced potentially malicious installation behavior.
remediation: Removed the suspicious dependency, pinned approved versions, and reviewed affected build artifacts.
outcome: Suspicious dependency confirmed and removed before production deployment.
feedback: Helpful: Reviewing dependency history identified the source.
lessons: Use dependency verification, version pinning, and software composition analysis.

title: Suspicious cloud account activity
description: A cloud account performed unusual API calls from an unfamiliar location, created new access credentials, and attempted to access sensitive storage resources.
root_cause: An exposed cloud credential was used to access resources outside the account's normal activity pattern.
remediation: Revoked exposed credentials, enforced stronger authentication, and reviewed IAM permissions.
outcome: Confirmed unauthorized cloud account access; suspicious credentials were revoked.
feedback: Helpful: Credential revocation prevented further unauthorized activity.
lessons: Monitor cloud identity changes, unusual API activity, and unexpected access key creation.

title: Credential dumping attempt detected
description: An endpoint detection alert identified an unusual process attempting to access sensitive operating system authentication processes.
root_cause: A malicious process attempted to extract authentication material after gaining elevated privileges.
remediation: Quarantined the suspicious executable, reset potentially exposed credentials, and reviewed privileged account activity.
outcome: Credential dumping attempt confirmed; successful credential extraction was not established.
feedback: Helpful: Endpoint telemetry helped distinguish attempted access from confirmed extraction.
lessons: Investigate suspicious authentication process access and distinguish attempted credential theft from confirmed compromise.
